messages.author: 8f9eadfacf260761
messages.subject: Migrating a PyMC3 model to PyStan: Kaggle NIH Seizure Prediction
parts:
Dear All,
Few months back, I participated in the https://www.kaggle.com/c/melbourne-university-seizure-prediction competition and I have used PyMC3 and Bayesian Logistic Regression.
Out of curiosity, I would like to implement the same model in PyStan.

All my code, data. and features That I have used are available here:
https://github.com/QuantScientist/kaggle-seizure-prediction-challenge-2016/blob/master/jupyter/bayesian-logistic-regression/ieegPymc3Version1.ipynb

Is anyone interested in joining forces on this? The competition is over, so there is no monetary reward (except for the challenge of course).

Also, this thread may be relevant; https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc3/issues/1167

Best,

Shlomo.
